summary.goal: Implement CultivateStorage interface and SqliteCultivateStorage class extending BaseSqliteStorage from @plannr/storage-base. Tables: signals, greenhouses, clusters, source_configs, filter_rules, ingestion_jobs, cultivate_config, with appropriate indexes for query performance. Full CRUD for all entities. Default Greenhouse auto-creation on initialize() when no greenhouses exist. Uses cultivate.db as the database file.

acceptance_criteria.description: CultivateStorage interface defines CRUD methods for all 7 tables
SqliteCultivateStorage extends BaseSqliteStorage with synchronous initializeSchema()
signals table has indexes on greenhouse_id, cluster_id, status, source_type+external_id (unique), created_at
greenhouses table stores mode, keyword_require (JSON), keyword_exclude (JSON), source_ids (JSON)
clusters table has index on greenhouse_id and trend
source_configs table stores auth as encrypted JSON, health status, consecutive_failures count
filter_rules table stores condition, effectiveness JSON, enabled flag
ingestion_jobs table tracks chunking progress with total_chunks, processed_chunks
On initialize(), if greenhouses table is empty, auto-creates a default Greenhouse (refinement mode, no keyword filters, all sources)
Signal queries support filtering by greenhouse_id, status, cluster_id with pagination (offset+limit)
cultivate_config table is a single-row key-value store for the current CultivateConfig JSON

steps.title: Define CultivateStorage interface
steps.description: Create src/storage/interface.ts. Define CultivateStorage interface with method signatures for all entities: signals (create, getById, update, list with filters, countByStatus, getByExternalId for dedup), greenhouses (create, getById, update, delete, list), clusters (create, getById, update, delete, listByGreenhouse, getByLabel), source_configs (create, getById, update, delete, list, updateHealth), filter_rules (create, getById, update, delete, list, updateEffectiveness), ingestion_jobs (create, getById, update, list), config (get, set). Also define query filter types for signal listing (SignalQueryFilters: greenhouse_id?, status?, cluster_id?, limit, offset).

acceptance_criteria.description: Interface covers all 7 entity types with full CRUD
Signal listing supports greenhouse_id, status, cluster_id filters with pagination
getByExternalId(source_type, external_id) enables exact dedup checks

steps.title: Implement SqliteCultivateStorage with migrations
steps.description: Create src/storage/sqlite.ts. Implement SqliteCultivateStorage extending BaseSqliteStorage. In initializeSchema(), create all tables: signals (id TEXT PK, greenhouse_id TEXT NOT NULL, source_type TEXT, external_id TEXT, title TEXT, body TEXT, author TEXT, author_type TEXT, url TEXT, score REAL DEFAULT 0, scoring_factors TEXT/JSON, cluster_id TEXT, status TEXT DEFAULT 'pending', provenance TEXT/JSON, tags TEXT/JSON, created_at TEXT, updated_at TEXT, linked_plan_id TEXT), greenhouses, clusters, source_configs, filter_rules, ingestion_jobs, cultivate_config. Add UNIQUE constraint on signals(source_type, external_id, greenhouse_id). Create all indexes.

acceptance_criteria.description: All 7 tables created with correct column types and constraints
signals(source_type, external_id, greenhouse_id) is UNIQUE for dedup
Indexes created on: signals(greenhouse_id), signals(cluster_id), signals(status), signals(created_at), clusters(greenhouse_id), clusters(trend)
initializeSchema() is idempotent (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS)

steps.title: Implement signal CRUD operations
steps.description: Implement signal methods: createSignal (INSERT with all fields, JSON.stringify for scoring_factors/provenance/tags), getSignalById, updateSignal (partial update with SET for provided fields, auto-update updated_at), listSignals (with SignalQueryFilters: WHERE clauses for greenhouse_id/status/cluster_id, ORDER BY created_at DESC, LIMIT/OFFSET), countSignalsByStatus (GROUP BY status for dashboard), getSignalByExternalId (for exact dedup lookup). Parse JSON fields back to objects on read.

acceptance_criteria.description: createSignal returns the created signal with generated id
updateSignal accepts partial updates and auto-sets updated_at
listSignals supports all filter combinations and pagination
JSON fields (scoring_factors, provenance, tags) are serialized on write and parsed on read

steps.title: Implement greenhouse CRUD with default auto-creation
steps.description: Implement greenhouse methods: createGreenhouse (INSERT with JSON serialization for keyword_require/keyword_exclude/source_ids arrays), getGreenhouseById, updateGreenhouse (partial), deleteGreenhouse, listGreenhouses. Add ensureDefaultGreenhouse() method called from initializeSchema(): if COUNT(*) FROM greenhouses = 0, insert a default greenhouse with name='Default', mode='refinement', empty keyword arrays, empty source_ids (all sources). JSON arrays for keyword_require, keyword_exclude, source_ids.

acceptance_criteria.description: Default greenhouse created on first initialize() when table is empty
Default greenhouse has mode='refinement', empty keyword filters, empty source_ids
Subsequent initialize() calls do not create duplicate defaults
keyword_require and keyword_exclude stored as JSON arrays

steps.title: Implement cluster CRUD
steps.description: Implement cluster methods: createCluster, getClusterById, updateCluster (partial — supports updating label, summary, signal_count, trend, velocity_weekly, velocity_monthly), deleteCluster, listClustersByGreenhouse (ORDER BY signal_count DESC), getClusterByLabel (for dedup during clustering). Trend and velocity fields default to 'stable' and 0 on creation.

acceptance_criteria.description: createCluster defaults trend to 'stable', velocities to 0
listClustersByGreenhouse returns clusters ordered by signal_count descending
updateCluster supports partial updates for trend detection and recluster

steps.title: Implement source_config CRUD
steps.description: Implement source config methods: createSourceConfig (INSERT with auth as encrypted JSON string), getSourceConfigById, updateSourceConfig (partial), deleteSourceConfig, listSourceConfigs (with optional enabled filter), updateSourceHealth (dedicated method that updates health status, increments/resets consecutive_failures, sets last_error). The auth field stores an encrypted JSON string — encryption/decryption is handled by the auth-encryption feature, storage just persists the opaque string.

acceptance_criteria.description: updateSourceHealth atomically updates health, consecutive_failures, and last_error
auth field stored as opaque encrypted string, not parsed by storage layer
listSourceConfigs supports filtering by enabled status

steps.title: Implement filter_rules, ingestion_jobs, and config tables
steps.description: Implement remaining entity methods. FilterRules: create, getById, update, delete, list (with optional enabled filter), updateEffectiveness (update signals_matched and false_positive_rate). IngestionJobs: create, getById, update (status, processed_chunks), list (with status filter). CultivateConfig: getConfig (single row), setConfig (UPSERT). The config table is a single-row store with key='current' and value=JSON string of the full CultivateConfig.

acceptance_criteria.description: updateEffectiveness atomically updates signals_matched and false_positive_rate for a filter rule
IngestionJob update tracks chunking progress (processed_chunks increment)
getConfig returns parsed CultivateConfig or null if not set
setConfig upserts (INSERT OR REPLACE) the single config row
